content: <thought>Based on the observed ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 180.042 likely corresponds to a [M+Na]⁺ adduct. Subtracting the sodium mass (22.989 Da) gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈157.053 Da. The formula that best matches this mass, considering typical organic elements (C, H, O) and the isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1 intensity indicating ~10‑11 carbons), is C₁₁H₉O (monoisotopic mass ≈ 157.065 Da). This fits the data within experimental error. Therefore, the molecular formula is C11H9O.
